team-resurrection v1.0.0

- Initial release of "Team Resurrection" for one-click migration, cloning, and backup of multi-agent teams.
- Supports three core scenarios: environment migration, in-place team cloning, and full team backup.
- Pack, migrate, and clone scripts provided to automate agent team deployment and recovery.
- All operations automatically back up existing configurations to ensure rollback safety.
- Includes detailed usage instructions, configuration strategies, and troubleshooting steps in SKILL.md.
